Are electric kettles a good choice for tea? From my experience, electric kettles stop only when the water is at a rolling boil, which is bad because: The water loses oxygen when at a rolling boil If you make teas other than black or herbals (like white, oolong or green) you may bruise the leaves with boiling water So are electric kettles recommended for tea making?
